website.readmeExcerpt:
﻿


Oh Hey !

Ever wanted to get notified when someone targets you or emotes at you? Now you can!
## Description Originally created by Mei, updated for 7.4 (7.5) by BnuuyAster Oh Hey! is a Dalamud plugin that has two main features currently: - Notifying you when someone targets you - Notifying you when someone emotes at you The plugin notifies you with a text message (only visible to you) and can optionally play a notification sound.\ Additionally it tracks the most recent notification events with a simple interface. ## Installation The plugin is available in the official repositories of [XIVLauncher](https://goatcorp.github.io/). You can install it by opening the plugin installer in the game (`/xlplugins`) and searching for "Oh Hey!". ## Documentation You can find the documentation for the plugin here: ## License This plugin is released under the terms of the AGPL-3.0 License. For more information, see [License](License.md)
